node.title: Re^3: Merging of custom array (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
set the OUTPUT_RECORD_SEPARATOR like say() does

I was surprised by this, and then noticed that you were referring to the [doc://say] docs. However, IMHO they're wrong, [doc://say] doesn't seem to set a [doc://local] [doc://$\], so I just filed [https://rt.perl.org/Public/Bug/Display.html?id=134298|bug #134298] to hopefully clarify/fix the documentation.

Update: A [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/commitdiff/c3d72fbe6ba0379|patch] has been applied, the [doc://say] docs in the next release will say:

Just like [doc://print], but implicitly appends a newline at the end of the LIST instead of any value [doc://$\] might have.
